name: PdxScrollArea
description:
A scrollable container that replaces the native scrollbars with styled, auto-hiding overlay
scrollbars, vertical, horizontal or on both axes.

members.name: type
members.description: Scrollbar visibility: auto (show on scroll+hover), always, hover (show on hover only), never

members.name: scrollHideDelay
members.description: Auto-hide delay in ms (0 = never hide). Used when type=auto

members.name: maxHeight
members.description: Max height (CSS value). Enables scroll when content overflows

members.name: label
members.description:
Names the scrollable area ("Release notes") and makes it a region landmark. Empty: no
landmark — the area stays focusable (tabindex 0) so the keyboard can scroll it.

members.name: scrollArea

type.text: { scrollTo(opts), scrollBy(opts), scrollIntoView(el, opts), getViewport(), recalculate() }

members.description:
Helpers over the inner viewport, reached as `el.scrollArea.scrollTo(…)`: the host is not
the element that scrolls, so the natives would act on the wrong box (which is also why
they are namespaced here rather than flattened onto the host).

events.name: pdx-scroll
events.description: The viewport scrolled: where it is, and how big the content and the viewport are.
events.detail: { scrollTop: number; scrollLeft: number; scrollHeight: number; scrollWidth: number; clientHeight: number; clientWidth: number }
